text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I'm sorry about that! Um, would<n>you grant us a
little of your time?

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
After our aquarium outing the other<n>day, Meek and I
got to talking about a<n>lot of things, and she said
something<n>that hit me hard.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
"I want to win it all with you. So I'll do<n>everything I
can to make that<n>happen."

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
So I think that's why she came up to<n>you all fired
up like that. Do I have<n>that right, Meek?

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text: You guys are like role models to us.

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text:
And you're rivals, too. Our rivalry<n>pushes us to
grow.

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text:
If we challenge each other, we'll get<n>stronger. Way
stronger, I bet.

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text:
That's why I'm making the first<n>move. I'm here to
challenge you.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Um... I'm on board with Meek and I'll<n>also give it
my all!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
I think it'll be good for all of us to<n>compare training
results and stats<n>and such...

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
So if it's not too much trouble, will<n>you consider
accepting her<n>challenge?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Just as she says, I do believe it<n>would be beneficial
for<n><chrname> too.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much! Isn't that great,<n>Meek?

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text: Thank you. I'll do my best.
